steps.title: Create CoastalVillageGenerator.gd
steps.description: Procedurally generates a coastal village map from a template. Three zones: beach zone (extraction), village zone (buildings and population), boundary zone (Fyrd arrival edges).

data_structure.description: generate() returns a dictionary consumed by RaidMission to build the scene.

format.extraction_zone: Rect2 — beach rectangle at map bottom edge
format.fyrd_boundary: Array of Vector2 — map top and side edges
format.navmesh_bounds: Rect2 — full walkable area excluding water

zones.beach_zone: Rect2 at map bottom. Height = beach_depth. Contains extraction zone rectangle. No buildings.
zones.village_zone: Remainder of map above beach. Buildings placed here with minimum spacing.
zones.boundary_zone: Outer 200px of map top and sides. Fyrd arrival positions sampled from here.

building_placement: Place Hall first at village center (village_zone center point)
Place Church if randf() < church_spawn_chance — offset from Hall
Place remaining buildings randomly within village_zone
Enforce minimum spacing of 120px between building centers
Maximum 20 attempts per building before skipping to prevent infinite loop
defender_placement: hall_defender_count defenders placed within 150px radius of Hall position
Remaining defenders placed randomly in village_zone away from beach
villager_placement: Minimum 80px from any defender spawn point

generate.description: Main entry point. If seed == -1 use randi(). Returns map data dictionary.

_place_buildings.description: Places buildings within village_zone respecting minimum spacing. Returns Array of placement data.

_sample_village_zone_position.description: Returns a random Vector2 within village_zone bounds.

_is_position_clear.description: Returns true if pos is at least min_distance from all positions in existing_positions.

steps.verify: Call generate() from a test script and print the returned dictionary. Confirm Hall is always present. Confirm building count is within min/max range. Confirm no buildings placed in beach_zone.

steps.title: Create UnitVisualizer.gd
steps.description: Handles all _draw() programmer art for units. Reads from UnitData. Attached to Base_Unit.tscn as a child node. Toggleable via debug flag.

functions._ready: Get unit_data reference from parent BaseUnit. Connect to health_changed signal if available.

_draw.description: Main draw function. Calls shape-specific sub-functions based on unit_data.debug_shape.

functions._draw_square: draw_rect(Rect2(-r, -r, r*2, r*2), unit_data.debug_color) where r = unit_data.visual_radius
functions._draw_triangle: draw_colored_polygon — three points forming upward triangle, filled with debug_color
functions._draw_diamond: draw_colored_polygon — four points forming diamond shape, filled with debug_color
functions._draw_health_bar: draw_rect for background (dark), draw_rect for fill (green to red based on current_health). Position: above unit.
functions._draw_facing_arrow: draw_line from Vector2.ZERO to facing_direction * facing_arrow_length, color WHITE, width 2
functions._draw_selection_ring: draw_arc full circle, color WHITE, width 1.5, radius = visual_radius + 4
functions.refresh: Call queue_redraw() — called by parent unit whenever state changes that affects visuals.

steps.verify: Units display correct shapes and colours in raid scene. Health bar visible. Facing arrow visible on squad leader.

steps.title: Implement UNAWARE and ALARMED states in UnitFSM
steps.action: MODIFY — add new state handling only
steps.before_writing: Show how existing states are handled in UnitFSM — specifically how update() dispatches per state — so new states follow identical pattern.

UNAWARE.description: Defender default state during raid. Unit stands idle. Runs LOS check each physics frame.
UNAWARE.on_enter: Stop movement. Play idle animation if available.
update: Run LOS detection — check if any player unit is within detection_range with clear line of sight
If player unit detected: transition to ALARMED
Detection range read from UnitData (add @export var detection_range: float = 300.0)
UNAWARE.los_check: Use RayCast2D or Physics raycast from unit position toward nearest player unit. If raycast hits player unit before hitting terrain, LOS is clear.

ALARMED.description: Defender has spotted player. Spreads alarm to nearby defenders then flees toward map boundary.
on_enter: Spread alarm: find all friendly units within 200px, call command_alarmed() on each
Set flee target: nearest point on map boundary (top or side edges)
update: If reached map boundary: emit signal alarm_raised — RaidObjectiveManager listens to this
If killed before reaching boundary: no alarm raised

verify: Approaching a defender causes them to transition to ALARMED
ALARMED defender moves toward map edge
Killing ALARMED defender before they reach edge prevents alarm_raised signal

steps.title: Implement Villager FLEEING state
steps.notes: RETREATING state already exists but moves toward a retreat zone. FLEEING is different — moves away from nearest threat.

FLEEING_state.on_enter: Find nearest player unit. Set flee_direction = (global_position - nearest_player.global_position).normalized(). Set flee_target = global_position + flee_direction * 800.0.
update: Every 60 frames recalculate flee_direction from nearest player unit
If flee_target reached: pick new flee_target in same general direction
If captured (proximity to player unit who has issued capture command): transition to ESCORTING

steps.villager_initial_state: Villagers spawn in FLEEING state immediately when raid begins — they are already panicking.
